Kaya (AE): Quick heads-up 1 — Prospect (Riverbank) wants a 2-week POC to migrate from CompetitorX. Scope: prompt parity, response diffs, pricing delta, and security questionnaire handoff. Can we split tasks?
Ben (ML Eng): Ill run the response-diff harness. Need a redacted 48h prompt export, median/p95 lengths, and whether they use streaming token hooks.
Kaya (AE): They stream, peak concurrent ~700. I'll request the export and traffic histogram.
Hana (Solutions Eng): POC plan: (1) tiny adapter to accept CompetitorX payload -> Redwood API, (2) replay on sandbox at throttled QPS, (3) run golden prompt suite + comparator. I can push starter proxy.
Hana (Solutions Eng): proxy example:
```
POST /proxy -> map body.text -> {"input": body.text, "model":"redwood-large", "temperature":0}
```
Ben (ML Eng): Parity runs: temperature=0, top_p=0.0, capture tokenizer outputs. CompetitorX applies light postproc (trim/normalize) 1 include that in comparator. Use embedding cosine + token Levenshtein.
Miles (Product): For pricing delta I need sequence histograms. Will present hosted vs dedicated vs Private cases and include batching/INT8 savings. Ask them for long-context flows.
Priyanka (Security): I'll handle the SQ. Need retention windows, SSO (SAML/SCIM), KMS/BYOK requirements, SIEM forwarding, and egress allowlist. If they insist on customer-managed keys well propose Private.
infra-bot: sandbox pool provisioned by Hana - pool_id=sbx-77 - attach egress range requested.
Kaya (AE): Proposed timeline: Days 1-2 adapter + infra, Day 3 replay capture, Days 4-6 parity analysis, Days 7-8 prompt mitigations + cost calc, Day 9 joint review. Sync in 6 business days. Please ack. :thumbsup:
Ben (ML Eng): ack
Hana (Solutions Eng): ack
Miles (Product): ack
Priyanka (Security): ack
Kaya (AE): Thanks 1 I'll share drive links and calendar invite.
